t: Clicked link in DHL email and typed my password | I got an email saying a parcel was held at customs, clicked the link and logged in with my work account before I realised the page looked off. Address bar said dhl-parcel-track.info. I have not changed my password yet, what do I do?

Possible phishing - did not click | Received an email 'Your mailbox is full, validate here' from an outside address pretending to be IT. I didn't click anything. Forwarding it so you can block it. Several people on my floor got it too.

Opened supplier invoice and enabled macros | Opened Invoice_88231.xlsm from what looked like our packaging supplier and clicked Enable Content. Nothing visibly happened but Excel closed by itself. Now I'm worried, the sender address was slightly different from usual.

Ransom note on Finance share | There's a file called README_RESTORE_FILES.txt in every folder on the Finance share (F:) and the spreadsheets won't open, they all have a weird .x7k3 extension. Started about 20 minutes ago and it seems to be spreading to more folders.

MFA prompts I didn't request | My Authenticator app keeps popping up approve requests, around 15 in the last hour. I'm not trying to log in anywhere. I denied them but I think I accidentally approved one while answering a call.

Sign-in alert from Lagos | Got an email from Microsoft about a successful sign-in to my account from Lagos, Nigeria at 06:40. I'm based in Lyon and have never travelled there. I can still log in normally.

Company iPhone left in a taxi | Left my company iPhone in a taxi last night in Madrid. It has Outlook, Teams and the payment approval app on it. Passcode is set. Can you lock and wipe it please? The taxi company hasn't found it.

Car broken into, work laptop gone | Someone smashed my car window at the train station parking this morning and took my work laptop from the boot. Police report is done. I think BitLocker is on. I had customer contracts saved on the desktop.

Customer export shared with 'Anyone with the link' | I just noticed the OneDrive folder with our full customer export (names, emails, phone numbers) is shared as 'Anyone with the link' and that link was sent to an external agency months ago. No idea who else has it now.

Service account password pasted in Teams channel | A colleague pasted the password of a domain admin service account in the Ops Teams channel (about 120 members) by mistake. He deleted the message after 10 minutes but people saw it and it was probably in notifications.
USB stick found in car park | Found a USB key labelled 'Salaries 2026 - confidential' on the ground near the staff entrance. I have NOT plugged it in. Who should I hand it to?

Plugged in trade fair USB, Defender went crazy | Got a free USB key at a booth at the expo yesterday, plugged it in to look at the brochure and Defender showed a bunch of red alerts about Trojan:Win32 and then the laptop rebooted on its own.

Unknown account added to Domain Admins | During the weekly AD review I found an account 'svc_backup2' added to Domain Admins on Saturday at 03:12. Nobody in the team created it and there is no change ticket for it.

Falcon critical detection on FIN-APP02 | CrowdStrike raised a critical detection on FIN-APP02 at 14:02: credential dumping via LSASS access, rundll32 calling comsvcs.dll MiniDump. Host is not contained yet. Please advise if we can isolate it, it runs the invoicing batch.

CEO asking me to buy gift cards | I got an email from 'our CEO' (from a gmail address) asking me to urgently buy 10 Apple gift cards of 200 EUR for clients and send him the codes, and not to tell anyone. I didn't do it. Is this real?

Supplier bank details changed - payment already sent | Accounts payable got an email from our logistics supplier with new bank details on their letterhead. We paid 84,300 EUR to the new IBAN on Tuesday. The supplier just called asking where their money is - they never changed their bank.

Leaver syncing engineering SharePoint to personal device | Heads up, an engineer who resigned (last day is Friday) has synced about 40GB from the engineering SharePoint to a non-managed device since Monday according to the DLP alerts. Please handle discreetly, HR is aware.

Outlook rule forwarding my mail outside | Found a rule in my Outlook called '..' that forwards every email containing 'invoice' or 'payment' to an external protonmail address. I definitely didn't create it.

Gave my MFA code to someone who texted me | Someone texted me saying they're from the helpdesk and needed the 6-digit code that had just arrived on my phone to 'finish the migration'. I gave it to them before realising. Really sorry.

Caller said he was Microsoft, I installed AnyDesk | A man called my desk phone saying he was from Microsoft licensing and asked me to install AnyDesk so he could fix 'license errors'. I did and he was on my screen for about 5 minutes before I got suspicious and pulled the network cable.

Hundreds of emails sent from my account | Several clients replied asking about a 'shared document' I supposedly sent this morning. My Sent Items has 300+ emails I did not write, all with the same link.
Defender: HackTool:Win32/Mimikatz detected | Got a Defender notification on my laptop: 'Threat found: HackTool:Win32/Mimikatz'. I'm a developer but I have never downloaded anything like that.

AWS keys exposed in public GitHub repo | GitHub secret scanning notified us that a repo pushed public yesterday contained production AWS access keys in config.yml. Repo is private now but it was public for about 16 hours.

Desktop wallpaper replaced by bitcoin demand | My desktop background suddenly changed to a red message asking for bitcoin and none of my documents open anymore. The laptop is still connected to the office wifi, should I unplug it?

Admin login on FortiGate at 02:47 from unknown IP | Firewall audit log shows a successful admin login on the FortiGate from a foreign IP at 02:47 followed by a full config backup download. None of us were working at that time.

Password spray against OWA | SIEM shows about 2,000 failed logins across 600 accounts from 3 IPs in the last hour against OWA. A few accounts are now locked and one service account had a successful login in the middle of it.

Entered password after scanning QR code in email | Scanned a QR code in an email about 'MFA re-enrolment required' with my phone and typed my work email and password on the page that opened. Then it just said thank you.

Accepted permissions for unknown app 'DocuView365' | Clicked a link to view a shared document and accepted a Microsoft consent screen for an app called DocuView365 that wanted to read my mail and files. Now I think that was a mistake.

Leaver account connected to VPN last night | VPN logs show jdubois, who left the company on 31 August, connected yesterday at 21:30 from a residential IP and stayed 2 hours. The account should have been disabled.

Phishing wave in Sales - at least 4 entered passwords | Since 9am a fake 'SharePoint document' email has been hitting the whole sales department. 4 people told me they entered their credentials. The link goes to sharepoint-docs-secure[.]com.

lost my bag on the train | left my bag on the RER this morning - work laptop, my access badge and a notebook with some passwords written in it (I know...). lost and found has nothing. what do I do first??

concern about a request from my manager | not sure this is the right place. my manager asked me to export the whole HR employee database incl salaries to his gmail 'to work from home on the weekend'. it feels wrong and I heard he is leaving next month. I haven't done it.
